validity.recommendation: Change Owner from 'General Petroleum Co 100%' to the actual Baltim South West concession partners Eni (IEOC) and BP, 50/50, held via Medgas (Eni/BP/EGPC) and operated by Petrobel. Verify whether the pipeline asset owner differs from the field owner before applying; if unresolved, at minimum flag GPC as unsupported.
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet lists Owner1 = 'General Petroleum Co' (GPC) at 100%. No independent source supports GPC any ownership stake in Baltim South West. GPC is a separate EGPC affiliate operating mostly Gulf of Suez assets and has no documented role here. Independent sources are consistent: oedigital.com (Reuters-sourced, 2019-09-17) states BP and Eni each hold 50% of the field, with Eni operating through subsidiary IEOC; NS Energy states the field is operated by Petrobel (an EGPC+IEOC JV) on behalf of Medgas, a JV of Eni, BP and EGPC. So the correct beneficial owners are Eni and BP (50/50) via the Medgas/EGPC structure, not GPC. Operator 'Belayim Petroleum Co' (Petrobel, Arabic بترول بلاعيم) is CORRECT and confirmed by both the Arabic sheet source (sfegypt.com) and NS Energy. This is an owner-attribution error, not an existence problem.

validity.recommendation: Keep P7577 as operating; keep it distinct from its sibling P7578. Note that 500 MMcf/d is the FIELD plateau target (initial flow was ~100 MMcf/d in 2019, ~235 MMcf/d actual by 2020), not a measured pipeline throughput; leave as-is with that caveat. Optionally reconsider PipelineType, since this is a dedicated offshore field-export line rather than a grid trunk.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real by multiple independent sources. This is the marine (sub-sea) leg of the Baltim South West gas export system, offshore Nile Delta ~12 km off the Baltim coast in ~25 m water, on stream since September 2019. Sources: NS Energy (project profile), oedigital.com (Reuters), offshore-energy.biz, plus the two Arabic sheet sources (sfegypt.com 2019-08-27, petro-news.com). DUPLICATE CHECK: P7577 (Sub-Sea, 18 km, 26 in) and P7578 (Onshore, 25 km, 26 in) are the two physical legs of ONE line, NOT duplicates of each other. NS Energy independently describes a single new 44 km / 26 in pipeline from the Baltim SW platform to the Abu Madi gas plant; 18 km sub-sea + 25 km onshore = 43 km, matching that 44 km within rounding. The Arabic sfegypt.com source explicitly names both a marine line (خط بحري) and a land line (خط بري), both 26 in. Correct segmentation. NOT a duplicate of GulfPub 'Baltim East - Abu Madi' (16 in, Baltim East field) or 'Baltim North - Abu Madi' (16 in, Baltim North field) - those are different fields/diameters. The auto-suggested GulfPub match 'Tuna - Denise Pipeline' (0.4958) is a FALSE lead (different offshore area). SPEC: diameter 26 in - high confidence (sfegypt + NS Energy agree). Length 18 km (sub-sea leg) - confirmed by sfegypt; combined 44 km corroborated by NS Energy. Capacity 500 MMcf/d = field plateau target, corroborated (oedigital, petro-news) though not a pipeline-metered figure. StartYear 2019 - high confidence. CLASSIFICATION caveat: technically a dedicated offshore field-to-plant export line, entered as 'transmission' per GEM Egypt convention; acceptable but not a national-grid trunk.

fills.researcher_notes: Operator [ref] was blank (MISSING_REF). Operator = Belayim Petroleum Co is Petrobel (Arabic بترول بلاعيم), an IEOC(Eni)+EGPC JV. Confirmed as operator by the Arabic sheet source (sfegypt.com names 'Petrobel' running the Baltim development) and by NS Energy ('Petrobel ... is the operator on behalf of Medgas'). Two independent sources.

The two existing Status refs (sfegypt, petro-news) are 2019/2024 completion-and-map articles that do not carry the literal token 'operating', so the verifier flagged them. Replacing/supplementing with sources that directly establish operating status: oedigital.com (Reuters, 2019-09-17) 'Baltim South West offshore gas field ... has started production'; NS Energy confirms production commenced September 2019 and the field remains on stream. Two independent sources.

routes.start_name: Baltim South West offshore production platform (Nile Delta, ~12 km off Baltim coast, ~25 m water depth)
routes.end_name: Baltim coast landfall (near Baltim, Kafr el-Sheikh) - tie-in to the onshore leg (P7578)
routes.corridor_desc: The sub-sea leg runs ~18 km roughly southward across the shallow Mediterranean shelf from the Baltim SW platform to a landfall on the Nile Delta coast at/near Baltim (Kafr el-Sheikh governorate), where it ties into the ~25 km onshore leg (P7578) continuing to the Abu Madi gas plant. Endpoints are sourced (NS Energy: field ~12 km offshore, ~25 m water, feeding Abu Madi via a 44 km / 26 in line; the 18 km marine + 25 km onshore split from sfegypt.com). Exact seabed alignment is not published, so the corridor is bounded by the platform location and the Baltim landfall rather than a surveyed route. Platform lat/lon is derived from Baltim town (~31.558N, 31.096E) offset ~12 km north; treat as approximate.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent reporting: NS Energy places the Baltim SW field/platform ~12 km off the Mediterranean coast in ~25 m water and states the gas is piped to the Abu Madi gas plant via a new 44 km, 26 in line; sfegypt.com splits that into an 18 km marine line + 25 km land line. Landfall coordinate taken from Baltim town; platform coordinate is Baltim offset ~12 km north (approximate, not a published coordinate). No coordinates were fabricated - the offshore point is a defensible offset from a named place and is labeled approximate.

summary: P7577 (Baltim SW sub-sea leg, 18 km/26 in) confirmed real and correctly segmented vs onshore P7578; specs/operator/start verified high; owner 'General Petroleum Co 100%' is a wrong attribution (actual partners Eni+BP 50/50 via Petrobel/Medgas).
